instruction.name: vld
instruction.description: Read whole vector from memory address `addr + offset`, save the data into `dst`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception. Note that you can use this intrinsic to load floating point vectors, even though the return type represents integer vectors.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r4' --asm 'vld $vr0, $r20, 0; vld $vr1, $r20, 16; vld $vr2, $r20, 32; vld $vr3, $r20, 48; vld $vr4, $r20, 64; vld $vr5, $r20, 80; vld $vr6, $r20, 96; vld $vr7, $r20, 112'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
